<div class="card-body">
'''Retract The Bridge''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">橋を収納せよ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の配備フェイズに、Xフォースを使用してデス・スターの屋内の位置カードの順番を入れ替える。X＝それらの位置カードの合計枚数、である。各位置カード上にあるカードは、位置カードとともに移動する。2：「絶体絶命」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Retract-The-Bridge-PSA-135901776.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">戦術に応じて橋を収納することにより、敵を混乱させ、通常の作戦行動を不可能にする。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Retract the bridge.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: During your deploy phase, use X Force to rearrange interior Death Star location cards. X = the total number of those location cards. Cards at each location card move with that location card.

2: Cancel On The Edge.

'''Lore:'''
By retracting bridges as tactics require, you confuse the enemy and make ordinary operations impossible.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 橋を収納せよ. On The Edge is 「絶体絶命」.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Retract The Bridge]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
